security.title: Security
security.mainOnly: You can change the email and password or delete the account only from the main device — so nobody with a stolen password can lock you out. Forgot the password? Use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page. Lost the main device? Contact support.

pass.title: Change password
pass.agree: I understand that changing the password signs me out on all devices except this one
pass.done: Password changed. Other devices need to sign in again

rules.upper: Starts with a capital Latin letter (A–Z)

email.title: Change email
email.hint: A letter with a link will be sent to the new address. Until you open it, the account email stays the same.
email.pending: Email sent to {email} — open the link in it. Not there? Check spam.

devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: The main device is the one you registered from. Only from it can you end any session and make another device the main one. Lost the main device? Contact support.
devices.none: No other sessions — the account is open only here
devices.revokeConfirm: End the session on “{device}”? You will need to sign in there again.
devices.revokeAllConfirm: End all other sessions? Those devices will need to sign in again.
devices.makeMainConfirm: Make “{device}” the main device? This device will stop being the main one.

del.title: Delete account
del.p1: Right after the request you will be signed out everywhere; the stream key and chat API key will stop working.
del.p2: In 3 days the account is deleted for good: rooms, channel, clips, stream recordings, rewards, emotes, presets, follows. Support can delete it earlier.
del.p3: Your messages in other people’s stream chats stay, but without your name — “Deleted user”.
del.p4: Changed your mind? Just sign in with your password within these 3 days and the deletion is cancelled.
del.agree: I understand that the account and everything in it will be deleted
del.confirm: Really delete the account? You will be signed out now and everything will be deleted in 3 days.
del.done: Request accepted. The account will be deleted on {date}. Changed your mind? Sign in with your password before then.

chat.title: Chat look
chat.hint: The color of your name in stream and room chats and in streamers’ OBS overlay.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.hint: What to show in the 🔔 bell in the site header. Opening the bell marks everything as read. Notifications are kept for 90 days.
notif.locked: Can’t be turned off — this protects your account.

support.title: 💬 Support
support.desc: Replies to your requests and decisions on your reports.

security.title: 🔒 Account security
security.desc: Sign-in from a new device, password, email and main device changes.

rooms.title: 🏠 Rooms
rooms.desc: An empty room will be deleted soon or was deleted after expiring.

channel.title: 📡 My channel
channel.desc: New followers and clips of your streams.

chat.title: 🛡️ Channel chats
chat.desc: You were made or removed as a moderator, banned or unbanned in a chat.

presets.title: 🧩 Presets
presets.desc: Your presets were added or liked; a preset was removed by moderation.

sup.title: Support
sup.mailOff: Replies currently come here and to the bell 🔔 — no emails are sent.
sup.mailOn: Replies currently come by email to your account address. There are no site notifications about them; the conversation is visible here.
sup.mailConfirm:
Support replies will be sent by email to {email}.

• You will no longer get site notifications about support replies — only emails.
• You can reply right to the email: it goes into the same conversation.
• Your requests and replies stay visible here in your profile.
• If the site has already sent all the emails it can today (daily limit) or the email fails, the reply will still come here, to the bell, with a note why.

You can turn this off at any time.
sup.mailOnToast: Support replies now come by email
sup.mailOffToast: Support replies now come to the site
sup.subject: Subject
sup.subjectPh: In short, what is it about
sup.empty: No requests yet. Have a question or something broke? Click “New request”.

fallback.mailLimit: here instead of email: the site’s daily email limit was reached
fallback.mailFailed: here instead of email: the email could not be sent

kind.accepted: Your request has been accepted for review. Thank you!
kind.trivial: Your request has been reviewed and processed.
